extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media seeking Salvation Army press contacts in the United States
extracted.subtask_description: A U.S.-focused media relations contact directory for The Salvation Army: instructions for where national vs. local media should direct inquiries and a listing of territorial/divisional/state press contacts with names, emails, and phone numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: National media relations handled by National Headquarters
rubrics_metrics.description: National media relations are handled by National Headquarters in Alexandria, VA, and its public relations consultant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: National-level media inquiries should be directed to National Headquarters (Alexandria, VA). The page also provides a separate National Media Request Form for national requests (see separate criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Local media should contact local representative first
rubrics_metrics.description: All local media are asked to first contact their local Salvation Army representative for requests for spokespersons and other inquiries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the territorial/divisional/state contacts listed on this page to reach the appropriate local representative for spokesperson requests and local media inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use National Media Request Form for national requests
rubrics_metrics.description: For national media requests, please contact us using the form below: National Media Request Form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit national media inquiries via the provided form rather than contacting local representatives; the form is the designated channel for national press requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find territorial press room contacts via interactive map
rubrics_metrics.description: Territorial Press Room Contacts: View the interactive map below to find your territorial press room contact: Central Territory, Eastern Territory, Southern Territory, Western Territory (each with named contacts and emails/phones).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The interactive map and the top-level territorial listings provide the primary contacts (name, email, phone) for territory-level media relations; use the listed territorial contact when the inquiry spans a territory rather than a single state.

rubrics_metrics.name: Divisional/state press contacts listed by state
rubrics_metrics.description: Divisional Press Room Contacts Listed by State — the page lists contacts for each state (and certain multi-state divisions), including contact name, email address, office phone and cell/mobile numbers where provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When contacting The Salvation Army for state- or local-level media matters, choose the contact entry for the relevant state or division; multiple divisions or shared divisions (e.g., 'Alabama, Louisiana & Mississippi Division') are explicitly indicated and should be used accordingly.
